mechanical NumPy force rejects nonpositive physical J before returning force; invalid_J does not trigger range-only raw capture

existing_v1_limitations: Complete-T accounting currently attributes every incomplete F only to recorded range trial; it cannot accept a predictor-base invalid_J deficit

Completed bases and trial forces retain original gates; unsupported/ambiguous before-F, missing linear row, unknown error or unexplained deficit fails closed
